title: artifact
$comment: A preserved objective artifact: schema doc, query, connection spec, contract, plan, deploy doc, handoff. Not narrative about work — the durable thing the work produced or depends on. Referenced by tasks/projects via edges (produces/implements).

kind.$comment: What sort of artifact, for routing/rendering.

path.$comment: Where the artifact lives (repo-relative path or store ref).

owner.$comment: The project/task/umbrella id this artifact belongs to.
